counting_rules.declaration_records: 1 per top-level declaration JSON record in the NDJSON stream (thm + def + opaque + axiom + quot + inductive; each inductive record folds its types, ctors, and recursors). Matches con-leche fold-record counting.
counting_rules.constants_unpacked: 1 per kernel constant added to the environment: thm + def + opaque + axiom + quot + inductive.types + inductive.ctors + inductive.recs. Matches nanoda constant-level counting.
